description: Read the consent proof for one phone number at a business: for service texts, marketing texts, calls and WhatsApp, the current status, when consent was given or taken back, how (web form, keyword, call, manual, API), the exact wording shown, and the stored proof (form page, form time, submission id), plus up to 50 history entries, newest first. Use it to answer a carrier or customer asking how someone opted in. IP addresses are never returned. found false means no consent record exists for that number. Read-only.
name: get_consent_proof
title: Get Consent Proof
